title: Design System: David Balaguer Cervera, personal landing

display.purpose: The H1 with the owner's name, once per page.

display-panel.purpose: The single oversized word of the help panel.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and table rows; tabular numerals.

nav.purpose: In-page navigation and the language switch (switch is 700).

model-line.purpose: Uppercase tracked title-block line in the header bar. Not an eyebrow.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked header cell of the parts table. Not an eyebrow.

callout.purpose: Part names beside circled letters in the hero drawing; smallest size in the system.

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: A part arriving in its drawing.

motion.name: duration-draw
motion.purpose: The dashed arrow flowing toward the socket.

motion.name: duration-seat
motion.purpose: The AI module arriving or seating.

motion.name: duration-pulse
motion.purpose: Half of the figure-mark pulse (yoyo, one repeat).

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between parts in a step drawing.

motion.name: distance-settle
motion.purpose: Parts rise into place from slightly below.

motion.name: distance-drop
motion.purpose: In a step drawing the AI module arrives from above.

motion.name: distance-flow
motion.purpose: Dash pattern slide along the arrow.

motion.name: ease-seat
motion.purpose: Small, firm landing of the AI module.

motion.name: ease-fade
motion.purpose: The arrow disappears late, under the module.

motion.name: scroll-start
motion.purpose: A step drawing plays once when its top reaches 85% of the viewport.

motion.name: pulse-scale
motion.purpose: Figure-mark scale at the peak of its pulse.

motion.name: css-ease-out
motion.purpose: CSS custom property --ease-out; used by button transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce leaves the authored drawings; beforeprint also reverts all tweens.

lineWeights.name: rule-heavy
lineWeights.purpose: Header rule, footer rule, help panel border, circled numbers and letters.

lineWeights.name: rule
lineWeights.purpose: Section rules, parts table, parts list, button borders, link underline thickness.

lineWeights.name: hairline
lineWeights.purpose: Dividers inside tables, lists and step rows.

lineWeights.name: drawing-hero
lineWeights.purpose: hero-assembly.svg and the part glyphs (cable glyph 3px).

narrative.overview:
The page is a flat-pack instruction sheet for one person's profile. Cool white paper, black line art, and a single process blue. A header bar with a heavy rule, a bordered parts list with 1× quantities, circled numbers for steps, circled letters (A Backend, B Frontend, C AI integration, D Automation) that tie every drawing to its text, and isometric figures with captions. It reads as a document first and a website second, which is the point: calm, exact, a little dry, with a visible sense of "everything has a place".

Density is moderate and structured. Text sits in narrow measures beside large drawings, and sections are separated by ruled lines instead of boxes or background changes. Personality comes from the drawings and from the manual's vocabulary, not from decoration. The build is light only (color-scheme: light); there is no dark theme and no accent beyond one blue.

PRODUCT.md commits the visual system to three durable constraints: it must not read as a dark/neon developer-portfolio template, as over-animated, or as AI hype (no glow, no magic gradients). The manual vocabulary answers all three by construction.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink, one blue. Blue is a signal, never a theme.
Every structure is drawn with an ink line (1px / 2px / 3px), never with a shadow or a fill block.
Square corners everywhere except pills (buttons) and circles (numbers and letters).
One family, Atkinson Hyperlegible, two weights (400, 700); hierarchy comes from size and weight.
Illustrations are authored isometric SVGs inlined in the page, animated by a small, quiet GSAP clock.
Motion is progressive enhancement: the authored figure is always the no-JS and reduced-motion state.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue appears on exactly three things: part C (the AI module) in drawings and glyphs, the primary action, and the circle of the process step that integrates AI. Nothing else is blue: not links, not headings, not rules, not hover states of ghost elements.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Neutrals do the work. If a new element needs emphasis, give it a heavier ink line or weight 700, not a tint.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: 400 reads, 700 labels and titles. A new level gets a size, not a new weight or family.

rules.name: The Tracked-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase letter-spacing exists only in two places the manual itself would put it: the title-block line in the header bar and the header cell of the parts table. It is not an eyebrow style and is never placed above a heading.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A new surface is a ruled box on the paper, never a card with a shadow, a blurred panel or a gradient fill.

rules.name: The Circle Means Reference Rule
rules.body: A circle is a pointer, not decoration: numbers for steps, letters for parts. A step number is paper with an ink ring; the AI step alone is blue-filled with white text. Part letters are identical in ES and EN and match between hero, parts list and glyphs.

rules.name: The One Pill Family Rule
rules.body: Pills are buttons and only buttons. Cards, tables, panels and labels stay square.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: Motion is enhancement over a complete static page. Nothing is hidden by CSS. Without JavaScript or under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, no tween is registered (gsap.matchMedia) and the drawings stay exactly as authored (the exploded figure: C beside its socket, arrow visible). CSS transitions collapse to 0.01ms. Before printing, every tween is reverted so unscrolled step parts are visible.

rules.name: The Once Rule
rules.body: Each animation plays once on load or first scroll. No loops, no scroll-linked scrubbing, no parallax, no hover choreography.

dos: Do keep the page paper-white (#f6f7f8) with ink (#121314) as the only text and line color; use Pencil Grey (#4a4d52) for captions and secondary notes.
Do reserve Process Blue (#2d5bff) for part C, the primary action and the AI step circle.
Do draw structure with ink lines: 3px for rules that frame the page, 2px for boxes, 1px Hairline Grey for dividers.
Do tie every drawing to text with a circled number or letter, and keep part letters identical in both locales.
Do show quantities as 1× in tables and lists.
Do keep content equivalent in ES and EN, including new sections, captions and labels.
Do give every new motion a duration, distance and ease from the clock in motion.ts, make it play once, and make sure the no-JS and reduced-motion state is a complete page.
Do keep a visible 3px ink focus ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glows, blurs or translucency.
Don't round cards, panels, tables or images. Rounded means a button pill or a reference circle, nothing else.
Don't use blue for links, headings, decoration, dividers or hover states of ghost elements.
Don't add a second typeface, a third weight, or type below 0.8125rem.
Don't add icons from a glyph font or icon library; if a pictogram is needed, draw it in the manual's isometric language.
Don't add a dark theme, neon or terminal styling.
Don't loop, scrub or parallax anything; don't hide content in CSS waiting for a script.
Don't invent evidence in drawings or captions (clients, metrics, named projects). Drawings depict the kit metaphor, never a specific project or client.
